m2mPath.label: M2M path (optional, leave blank for default)

verifyTls.label: Standard certificate chain and hostname verification (only without fingerprint)

certificateFingerprint.label: SHA-256 certificate fingerprint (optional, independently verified only)

fingerprintNotice.text: A configured fingerprint takes precedence over the checkbox. Use only an independently verified fingerprint. With neither option enabled, the gateway identity is not verified.
